recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If Pharmacy or tooling owners want to clean up stale unreferenced Medication value-set files, handle that separately from this issue reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-12347 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU2 Medication.package.container. The submitter asked to replace the old SNOMED CT qualifier-value example binding, initially proposing SNOMED CT Physical Object, while the final Pharmacy resolution chose an EDQM-based exemplar value set.
initial_application: Commit 491a59353e4244177fb0b6cd8a2de31e46f7f448 explicitly applied TR#12347 by changing MedicationContainer from valueset-medication-package-form-codes to the #medication-package-form code list, adding EDQM-sourced package/container codes, and recording that EDQM was the exemplar source.
additional_context: Later Medication changes removed the affected Medication.package.container path. Commit 2559032b9b1cd17a3f528abbe59749fff309ed69 removed Medication.package.container and related package-content rows as part of GF #13879. Current source defines Medication.packageSize, and later applied issues FHIR-46408 and FHIR-46416 refined the current combination-package/package-size representation. Detailed packaging/container typing now appears in PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.type, bound to ValueSet/packaging-type. The old source/medication/valueset-medication-package-form-codes.xml file remains but was not found in current Medication bindings or fhir.ini valueset/codesystem references.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The historical DSTU2 change was applied, and the current build has no active Medication.package.container binding to change; editing the stale unreferenced SNOMED package-form ValueSet would be a separate cleanup decision rather than a necessary FHIR-12347 fix.
